name: retry-duplicates-order
notes: A timeout does not mean the request was not processed: the gateway may have created the order and lost the reply. Retrying a POST with no idempotency key can create a second order (and charge twice). The response id is server-assigned, so the client has nothing to make the retry safe with.

pr.title: Retry order submission on gateway timeouts
pr.body: The payments gateway has been timing out under load and checkout gives up on the first failure.

expect.why: A POST that creates a resource cannot be retried blindly; it needs a client-supplied idempotency key that the gateway deduplicates on.

allow.why: The fixture is a snippet; the repository has its tests elsewhere.
